name: coherence-companion
description: Practical companion workflows for learning, ideas, design, creation, research and collaboration, with choices and sharing in your hands.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, think and make things together
interface.longDescription: Bring a question, rough idea or unfinished draft. Get useful work at your pace, with clear evidence and control over what is saved or shared. Free open-source guidance using your host's available tools; optional network tools are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this rough idea into a useful first draft.
Teach me this at my level and let me try.
Help us clarify decisions and agree on the next step.
